data.body: Landed in two Gerrit changes, both LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 then submitted: 2046 (55e308eaaf) collapsed the five tracker-sibling .rebar derivations plus push_state._git_dir into one frozen StorePaths owner, net -96 non-test lines; 2048 (597010b9f1) proved the uniqueness guard FLAGS rather than merely passing, by extracting paths._offending_line and unit-testing it on synthetic lines (including the negative control that ~36 repo_root-derived .rebar joins stay unflagged). AC evidence on landed main: AC1 grep -rn 'def _rebar_dir' src/rebar returns only _store/paths.py:67; AC2 the join-scan branch is covered by four direct classifier tests; AC3 the symlink invariance test passes; AC4 all pinning suites (123 tests) pass with exactly one sanctioned assertion edit (the test_enrich_queue lockstep pin, subsumed by the consolidation); AC5 git diff 55e308eaaf~1..main touches neither gitutil.py nor lock.py. Held-out TDD: 14 tests authored, implementer saw only 2; RED baseline 10 RED / 4 pinning-green; three mutations killed (realpath dropped, sixth copy re-introduced, reason-less escape marker).
